# List user spreadsheets
  /spreadsheets --list_all

# Curl variant
  curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "message": {
        "message_id": 1,
        "text": "/spreadsheets --list_all",
        "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
        "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
        "date": 1700000000
      }
    }'
